teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

facts.label: Conselhos e frequência
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselhos: You should practice every day. Pergunte How often do you practice? e How long does it take?

facts.label: Should
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para dar conselhos: You should practice every day. A forma é a mesma para todas as pessoas: I should, she should, they should.

facts.label: How often
facts.sub: Para perguntar a frequência, use How often…? A resposta usa every day, two times a week, once a month ou palavras como always, usually e never.

pages.title: A music room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday afternoon in a music room in Miami. Warm light comes through a big window. Ines sits on a chair with a piano book. Her friend Mia comes in with a new guitar. The guitar is still shiny and clean. Ines smiles and asks about it.
“Hi, Mia! Is that your new guitar?” says Ines. “Yes! I’m learning it. I have a lesson on Tuesdays.” says Mia. “How often do you practice?” says Ines.
